## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy. He possesses a big, fat face paired with little blue eyes, and his ears stick out prominently like flaps.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a dedicated individual whose primary ambition is to become a minister. His life's path and focus are defined by this singular, long-standing goal.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md)

Moody Spurgeon is a schoolmate and academic peer of [Anne](../character/anne.md). Along with their fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students, they bond over the shared stress and anxiety surrounding the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations. They continue to support and encourage each other as they navigate their studies and adjust to life away from home.

- Friend of — schoolmates who discuss their examination fears and encourage each other  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P20](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0020)</sub>
